title: Should Students Wear Uniforms?
text:
Many people think that students should wear school uniforms. They believe uniforms make all students look equal, so no one feels poorer or richer than others. Uniforms can also make mornings easier, because students do not need to choose clothes every day. For these reasons, many schools have decided to use uniforms.

Some students dislike uniforms because they want to express their own style. However, a uniform can still allow small choices, such as shoes or a bag. Schools should listen to students and find a fair balance. In the end, a uniform can help a school community feel more united.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, why can uniforms make mornings easier?
options: Students do not need to choose clothes every day.
Students can sleep longer at school.
Uniforms are always cheaper for families.

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what can a uniform still allow?
options: Small choices, such as shoes or a bag.
Changing the name of the school.

questions.text: Why do some students dislike uniforms?
options: They want to show their own personal style.
They think uniforms are too expensive to wash.
They do not like their teachers.
They want to wear school clothes at home.

questions.text: What is the writer's overall opinion about school uniforms?
options: They can be useful if schools also respect student choice.
They should be banned in all schools.
They are only useful for sports teams.
They are useful only for teachers.

paragraph_translations: Birçok insan öğrencilerin okul üniforması giymesi gerektiğini düşünüyor. Üniformaların tüm öğrencilerin eşit görünmesini sağladığına inanıyorlar, böylece hiç kimse diğerlerinden daha fakir ya da daha zengin hissetmiyor. Üniformalar sabahları da kolaylaştırabilir, çünkü öğrencilerin her gün kıyafet seçmesi gerekmiyor. Bu nedenlerle birçok okul üniforma kullanmaya karar verdi.

Bazı öğrenciler üniformayı sevmiyor, çünkü kendi tarzlarını ifade etmek istiyorlar. Yine de bir üniforma, ayakkabı ya da çanta gibi küçük seçimlere izin verebilir. Okullar öğrencileri dinlemeli ve adil bir denge bulmalı. Sonuç olarak, bir üniforma okul topluluğunun daha birlikte hissetmesine yardımcı olabilir.
